The second closes the block: 'This topological characterization replaces heuristic chemistry with a rigid sub-Hopf link invariant.' It is near-identical in construction to the closer I flagged on rem:metallic-character-knot-novelty ('A rigid topological invariant replaces qualitative chemical models'), which suggests a template rather than two independent conclusions.

Proposed: drop the blockquote, since the sentence before it already says a closed sub-link is one where every curl fully interlocks; and replace the closer with what the block can support. FINDING that the closer's companion sentence is contradicted by its own parent: 'It formally binds empirical ionization energy peaks to crossing-energy maxima.' The parent prop:noble-gas-characterization carries a dated authorNotes caveat (2026-06-16) saying the opposite — that an exploratory 50-dps computation of sigma_F along the electron-dressing chain 'does not support the Relation to ionization energy mechanism as written: sigma_F(k) decays monotonically along the chain rather than peaking at closed shells', and that 'the ionization-energy and shell-closure claims are interpretations pending a categorical derivation, not results'. 'Formally binds' asserts precisely the derivation the caveat records as absent. Proposed: 'It suggests a correspondence between ionization-energy peaks and crossing-energy maxima, not yet derived (see the caveat on the parent proposition).'
